Account brief — Example Analytics (example.com), 2026-10-12.
- What they do: sells a usage-analytics product to operations teams at software companies (example.com/).
- Opened four sales roles in Berlin on 2026-10-01 (example.com/careers).
- Raised a $30M Series B led by Example Ventures on 2026-09-18 (news.example.com/example-analytics-series-b).
- Launched usage-based pricing for the Growth plan on 2026-08-04 (example.com/blog/usage-pricing).
- Likely problem owner: Head of Operations (a guess, based on the careers page placing billing operations in the operations team).
Angles: usage-based pricing makes usage-to-billing reconciliation a monthly job; a fast-growing sales team adds invoices to reconcile.
Open questions: which billing system they use; how many people close the month; customer count.
